'''Stealth field reinforcement''' visors were upgraded [[stealth field enhancer]]s in production during and prior to the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They were designed to regulate stealth field emissions and improve the user's perception while using a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]].
